description: Catalog search for discovery: find live events on XP -- concerts, sports, theater -- by performer, team, venue, city, or keyword (e.g. 'shows near me this weekend', 'Taylor Swift tour dates'). Returns event cards from the XP catalog with a fee-inclusive price preview, for browsing and navigation. When the question is what an event is trading at -- the marketplace get-in price and whether fans are selling into it -- use search_market instead. To look up a performer or venue by name on its own, use search_performers or search_venues. Not for scores, news, standings, or non-ticketed listings.

cbsa.description: Metro area filter (synonyms: city, near me, area). ISO US CBSA code or name.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

max_date.description: Filter events on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). For relative phrases like 'this weekend' or 'next month', resolve against _meta.context.today.

min_date.description: Filter events on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). For relative phrases like 'this weekend' or 'next month', resolve against _meta.context.today.

name: search_events
title: Search Events
